fam.title: Family profiles
fam.intro: One phone, the whole family. Give each person their own checklist, Quran log, badges and streaks.
fam.how: Each profile keeps its own progress on this device, and can have its own account and competition. Switch from this screen at any time. The language, theme and prayer location are copied to a new profile.
fam.note: Profiles stay on this device. Anyone holding the phone can open any profile, so they are for sharing, not for privacy.
fam.mineHint: Names the profile you are using now
fam.addHint: The app opens the new profile straight away. Your own progress is kept in your profile.
fam.max: This device can hold up to 8 profiles.
fam.failed: The profile could not be changed. Your device storage may be full.
fam.removeBody: This profile's progress on this device is deleted permanently. A cloud account it signed in to is not deleted.
fam.rowOff: Share this device with your family
buddy.title: Buddies
buddy.intro: Invite a friend or family member to see how you are doing and to encourage you. Follow them back to do the same.
buddy.startTitle: Let a buddy keep you on track
buddy.startBody: Create a private link and send it to someone you trust. They see a short summary of your progress, never your checklist or journal.
buddy.nameHint: Shown to the people you invite
buddy.started: Your buddy link is ready. Send it to a friend.
buddy.shareBody: Anyone with this link can see your summary and send you encouragement.
buddy.stopBody: Your buddy link stops working for everyone who has it. You can create a new one later.
buddy.privacy: Buddies see only: your Ramadan day, today's completion, your best current streak, days logged, Quran pages and when you were last active.
buddy.inviteText: {name} invites you to be an accountability buddy on Ramadan Strivers. Open the link to follow their progress and encourage them:
buddy.unavailable: Buddies need the Ramadan Strivers server, which is not available here.
buddy.gone: This buddy link is no longer active.
buddy.pendingBody: {name} invited you to follow their progress and encourage them.
buddy.empty: When a friend sends you their buddy link, open it and they appear here.
buddy.encourageBody: Choose a message. They see it the next time they open the app.
buddy.nudge.keepGoing: Keep going, you are doing well
buddy.nudge.proud: Mashallah, I am proud of you
buddy.rowOff: Invite someone to keep you on track
cal.title: Add Ramadan to your calendar
cal.rowSub: The 30 days, iftar times and Eid
cal.body: Download a calendar file for Ramadan {year} AH, starting {date}. Open it to add the days to your phone or computer calendar.
cal.withTimes: Each day includes the end of suhoor and the time of iftar for your saved location.
cal.noTimes: Set your location in Settings to include suhoor and iftar times.
cal.moonNote: Dates follow the calculated calendar and your moon-sighting setting. Your community may start or end a day earlier or later.
cal.name: Ramadan {year} AH
cal.lastTen: The last ten nights begin tonight at sunset.
cal.oddNight: Tonight is night {n}, an odd night: seek Laylat al-Qadr.
cal.iftarDesc: Make dua before you break your fast.
cal.compRowSub: Key dates with your join link
cal.compLastTen: {name}: the last ten nights begin tonight
embed.rowSub: Show it on your school or mosque website
embed.title: Embed the leaderboard
embed.body: Paste this code into your website. The leaderboard updates by itself and shows a link to join.
embed.note: It shows display names, teams and points only, the same as the leaderboard in the app. Hidden participants stay hidden.
embed.heading: Leaderboard
embed.failed: The leaderboard could not be loaded.
ins.empty: Insights appear once participants start logging their days.
ins.overviewSub: Active now means logged in the last 3 days. Completion and days are averages for participants who have started. Khatms is Quran pages divided by 604. Invited counts personal links not opened yet.
ins.activeSub: How many people logged something on each day of Ramadan.
ins.pctSub: The average share of the daily checklist completed by those who logged.
ins.retSub: How many participants have logged at least this many days.
ins.spreadSub: Participants grouped by their average daily completion.
ins.momSub: Most points in the last 3 days.
ins.quietSub: Started, but nothing logged in the last 3 days. A kind reminder may help.
ins.never.one: {n} participant joined but has not logged a day yet.
ins.never.other: {n} participants joined but have not logged a day yet.
disp.title: Home display
disp.rowSub: A clock, prayer countdown and iftar time for a tablet, smart display or TV
disp.setLocation: Set your location for prayer times
